changes.after: Both auxiliary noises are Gaussian and are independent of each other and of \(q\), with covariances \(\theta I/a\) and \(\theta I/b\).
changes.before: The noises are independent of each other and of \(q\), with covariances \(\theta I/a\) and \(\theta I/b\).

findings.quote: The determinant identity is supported for jointly Gaussian auxiliary contacts. Gaussian q plus independent noises with specified covariances does not alone establish that law. Add the Gaussian-noise assumption before identifying this determinant functional with I(x;y|z).
